recipe.coordinates: XInput, up-positive Y; invert Y when constructing Linux HIL phases
recipe.frontside_candidate: Clockwise, starts LS right; x=cos(angle), y=sin(angle), angle decreases from zero.
recipe.backside_candidate: Counterclockwise, starts LS left; angle increases from pi.
recipe.nollie: Reverse RS Y only under default REVERT_NOLLIE_MIRROR=false.
recipe.tail: Center LS, retain RS setup, then release override.
recipe.rt_default: REVERT_SWAP=true routes RT to the frontside candidate; old header comments are stale.
recipe.scheduler: 500 Hz loop; accumulate deadlines with catch-up when at most 50 ms late, otherwise resynchronize.
